content: {"question":"If I want to pay for a conference using a virtual card issued by the company, which policy should I consult to understand reimbursement rules?","answer":"You should refer to the Global Travel and Expense Policy for guidance on reimbursement and procedures.","evidence":"Please see our [Global Travel and Expense Policy](/handbook/finance/expenses/) to see what we will reimburse and how to get reimbursement."}
